fact: UNICEF's country profile, compiled from December 2016 to November 2017, says births, marriages and deaths are processed electronically, all vital events being recorded directly in the computer using applications available in all municipalities of the country at the civil registry conservatories, with civil registration services in all 22 municipalities but stations only in their urban centres, rural areas being reached by mobile teams and by registration in health structures.
title: CRVS - Birth, Marriage and Death Registration in Cabo Verde
